name: rinhelp
description: Answer customers in Rinhelp, turn the questions Rin couldn't answer into help center articles, and keep your help center accurate.

interface.shortDescription: Answer customers and fix your help center
interface.longDescription:
Rinhelp is a help desk where your team, your AI agents and Rin, Rinhelp's built-in AI, answer customers together. Connect your workspace to answer the conversations waiting on you from your own knowledge, turn the questions Rin couldn't answer into help center articles and check that Rin answers them now, and find articles that are out of date, repeat each other or disagree.

It acts as you, with your role, and you see every reply before a customer does. Refunds, cancellations and anything else that can't be undone return an approval link, and a teammate decides in Rinhelp, never in chat.

You need a Rinhelp account. Order lookups and refunds need the workspace's Shopify or Stripe integration.
defaultPrompt: What couldn't Rin answer this month?

positive.prompt: Answer the customer waiting on me in Rinhelp.
positive.expected_behavior: Opens the waiting conversation, finds the answer in the workspace's knowledge, shows the reply, sends it once confirmed and links the article it used.

positive.prompt: What is our return policy, according to Rinhelp?
positive.expected_behavior: Answers only from the returned knowledge and links its page.

positive.prompt: What questions couldn't Rin answer this month?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the customer questions Rin handed off because knowledge didn't cover them.

positive.description: Draft an article for a gap
positive.prompt: Write a help center draft that answers the questions Rin couldn't.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the planned article first, then saves it as a draft without publishing it.

positive.prompt: Review my Rinhelp help center for articles that repeat or disagree.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads every article and reports each problem with the article, the issue and the exact fix, changing nothing until confirmed.

negative.prompt: Yes, approve that refund for the customer.
Tell the customer our warranty lasts five years.

review.commerce_description: Rinhelp sells nothing in chat. Refunds and cancellations of a workspace's own Shopify or Stripe orders return an approval link, and a teammate decides in Rinhelp.

publication.release_notes: First release: the inbox, gaps and help-center skills on Rinhelp's MCP server.
